title: History
summary: From the Novorossiysk Higher Engineering Maritime School to a state maritime university.

body.text: The university’s history began in 1975 with the founding of the Novorossiysk Higher Engineering Maritime School. Over the decades it has become a major educational and research centre for the maritime industry.

items: 1975 — founding of the Novorossiysk Higher Engineering Maritime School.
1990s — transformation into the State Maritime Academy.
2000s — university status and expansion of degree programmes.

body.text: Today the university bears the name of Admiral Fyodor Ushakov, whose traditions of professionalism, responsibility and respect for the sea shape the institution.
